title: Pigsteel to Inferrum
description: A resourcepack that changes the name of items and blocks from the mod Pigsteel, to use the word "Inferrum".
body:
I made a simple Resourcepack that changes the name of the items and blocks from the mod "Pigsteel" to Inferrum.
I simply think it makes sense given iron can be obtained thanks to the mod resources, and not steel, it may also fit some Modpacks better, and, I think it is a cool, fitting name.

Infernus+Ferrum (Iron) = Inferrum

I've also included a es_es translation, that localices it to "Infierro".

I don't mean any disrespect towards the Pigsteel DEVS, whom I thank for creating the mod in the first place, you can find the mod for Forge and Fabric:

[Pigsteel [Forge]](https://modrinth.com/mod/pigsteel-forge)
[Pigsteel [FABRIC]](https://modrinth.com/mod/pigsteel-fabric)

I tested this with the Fabric version, if anything goes wrong in Forge or you want to talk about anything you can find me as @Jasdan in Discord.

You are free to include this Resourcepack, partially or on it's enterity on Modpacks, or as part of a mod, you may also rehost it if you require to do so.
